object_transcript:
Mrs. Boyett's Angel Food Cake

Do not preheat oven 325°

1 ½ cups cake flour
2 cups sugar
1 ½ cups egg whites
½ teaspoon salt
1 ½ teaspoon cream of tartar
1 ½ teaspoon vanilla
1 teaspoon almond extract

Sift flour once before measuring
and set aside until needed
to measure sugar and
divide into 2 equal parts.
Add ½ of sugar to the
flour and sift the 2 ingredients
together 4 times. Sift
the remaining sugar 4 times.
Do all this before starting
to beat the egg whites.
Add salt to egg whites &
beat until foamy. Add
cream of tartar & continue
beating until stiff but not
dry. Then add ½ the
sugar to the egg whites,
2 Tablespoons at a time.
If using an electric
mixer use low speed to

do this. Use a whisk
beater if beating by hand.
Add the flavoring. Do
not use the electric
mixer to add the
remaining ingredients, but
use a wire whisk egg
beater. Fold in the flour
& sugar mixture, adding
it to egg whites, 2
Tablespoons at a time. Fold
in with slow, careful
strokes. Pour into pan.
Cut down through cake
batter with knife
to remove any large
bubbles. Bake for about
65 minutes. When
cold remove from pan.
